title: Dice of Kalma - reconstructed design reference
scope: Installed Android build. Complete extracted Item inventory; not the original internal design document or exhaustive runtime verification.

skulls.name: Ace Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if the sum of the three smallest dice is smaller or equal to the largest die.

skulls.name: Archer Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if the difference between the smallest and the largest die is smaller than 3.

skulls.name: Astronaut Skull
skulls.condition: When starting a new level if only half or fewer of the hands of the previous level were played.
skulls.example: The previous level was finished with only a single hand having been played.

skulls.name: Automaton Skull
skulls.condition: When rerolling at least one die into a number equal to hands left. Once per hand.
skulls.example: Reroll 23456 into 13456 when there is one hand left.

skulls.name: Bachelor Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if the product of the second and the fourth die is larger or equal to the the sum of all the dice.

skulls.name: Bandaged Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand with a smaller sum of dice than the initially rolled hand.
skulls.example: Play 11111 when the initially rolled hand was 11112.

skulls.name: Bettor Skull
skulls.condition: When rerolling without changing the rank of the hand. Once per hand.
skulls.example: Reroll a Pair into a Pair.

skulls.name: Blank Skull
skulls.condition: This skull does not do anything.

skulls.name: Blind Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if no dice were rerolled.
skulls.example: Play a hand without rerolling any dice.

skulls.name: Bolted Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand that contains three adjacent dice with the same number.

skulls.name: Bomb Skull
skulls.condition: When rerolling exactly one die into a number equal to the amount of dice rerolled. Once per hand.
skulls.example: Reroll 11111 into 34511 when three dice were rerolled.

skulls.name: Candle Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if out of rerolls.
skulls.example: Play a hand when out of rerolls.

skulls.name: Captain Skull
skulls.condition: When rerolling exactly one die into the number 1. Once per hand.

skulls.name: Carnival Skull
skulls.condition: After a reroll if all dice in hand differ from their adjacent dice by more than one. Once per hand.

skulls.name: Chef Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if the sum of the dice is less than 15.

skulls.name: Chieftain Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if at least two of the three dice in the middle are equal to each other.

skulls.name: Choked Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if the largest amount of similar dice is equal to hands or rerolls.
skulls.example: Play 11122 when there are 3 rerolls left.

skulls.name: Clairvoyant Skull
skulls.condition: When rerolling at least three dice into the same number with a single reroll. Once per hand.

skulls.name: Dj Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if the sum of the first and the last die is 6 or 8.

skulls.name: Daredevil Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand that is higher rank than the previous played hand.
skulls.example: Play a Two Pair when the previous played hand is a Pair.

skulls.name: Dealer Skull
skulls.condition: After a reroll if the rank of the hand was reduced by the reroll. Once per hand.
skulls.example: Reroll a Two Pair into a Pair.

skulls.name: Demon Skull
skulls.condition: When the initially rolled hand is higher rank than the previous played hand.
skulls.example: The initially rolled hand is a Two Pair when the previous played hand is a Pair.

skulls.name: Doctor Skull
skulls.condition: When starting a new level.

skulls.name: Drilled Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if at least two of the three middle dice are equal to the first or last die.

skulls.name: Drinking Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if the smallest or the largest die is equal to hands left.
skulls.example: Play 23456 when there are 2 hands left.

skulls.name: Executioner Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if every die is different from its adjacent dice.

skulls.name: Fisher Skull
skulls.condition: When the initially rolled hand is a Pair.
skulls.example: The initially rolled hand is a Pair.

skulls.name: Florist Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if no dice differ from their adjacent dice by more than 1.

skulls.name: Fractured Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a High Die.

skulls.name: Fungal Skull
skulls.condition: When rerolling any amount of dice into a High Die or Straight. Once per hand.

skulls.name: Gambler Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand that is lower rank than the previous played hand.
skulls.example: Play a Pair when the previous played hand is a Two Pair.

skulls.name: Gamer Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if the sum of the first and the last die is equal to hands or rerolls.
skulls.example: Play 12321 when there are two hands or rerolls left.

skulls.name: Geek Skull
skulls.condition: When rerolling at least one die into the sum of its two adjacent dice. Once per hand.

skulls.name: Guard Skull
skulls.condition: When reaching the last hand in a level.
skulls.example: There is only one hand left.

skulls.name: Hacker Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if the sum of the dice is divisible only by itself.
skulls.example: The sum of the dice is a prime number, such as 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19, 23 or 29.

skulls.name: Half Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if the difference between the two first dice is equal to the difference between the two last dice.

skulls.name: Inventor Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if at least one die is equal to the difference between its two adjacent dice.

skulls.name: Jester Skull
skulls.condition: When rerolling at least one die without changing its number. Once per hand.
skulls.example: Reroll a die with the number 1 back into the number 1.

skulls.name: Jolly Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if the smallest die is equal to rerolls spent on the hand.

skulls.name: Judge Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if there are no dice with numbers 1 or 6.

skulls.name: Knight Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if the amount of hands left is even.
skulls.example: Play a hand when there are 2 hands left.

skulls.name: Machine Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if at least one die is equal to rerolls left.
skulls.example: Play 11123 when there is one reroll left.

skulls.name: Masque Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if there are more rerolls than hands left.
skulls.example: Play a hand when there are 2 hands and 3 rerolls left.

skulls.name: Merchant Skull
skulls.condition: When rerolling the dice into ascending or descending order. Once per hand.
skulls.example: After a reroll, the hand is 12234 or 54333.

skulls.name: Mercy Skull
skulls.condition: After spending the last reroll if there is only one hand left. Once per level.
skulls.example: Use your last reroll when there is only one hand left.

skulls.name: Miner Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if all dice are even or all dice are odd.

skulls.name: Musketeer Skull
skulls.condition: When reaching the middle hand of a level.
skulls.example: Reach the third hand of a level that started with four or five hands.

skulls.name: Nailed Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if the first, the last and at least one other die all have the same number.

skulls.name: Nerd Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if at least one die is equal to the sum of its two adjacent dice.

skulls.name: Occult Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if the sum of the dice is divisible by 5.

skulls.name: Officer Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if the number on at least one die corresponds to its position in hand.

skulls.name: Opera Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a Two Pair.

skulls.name: Party Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if every other die is even and every other is odd.

skulls.name: Pilot Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if the sum of the first and the last die is larger than the sum of the dice between them.

skulls.name: Pirate Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand that contains a die with the number 1.

skulls.name: Pot Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if the sum of the dice is larger than 22.

skulls.name: Princess Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if at least 3 rerolls were spent on the hand.
skulls.example: Play a hand after spending 3 rerolls.

skulls.name: Queen Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if the amount of unique dice numbers is smaller than the amount of rerolls spent on the hand.
skulls.example: Play 11123 after spending at least four rerolls.

skulls.name: Ritual Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if the sum of the three dice in the middle is divisible by 3.

skulls.name: Royal Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand that contains a die with the number 6.

skulls.name: Scholar Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if the dice are in ascending or descending order.

skulls.name: Shaman Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if the sum of odd dice is larger than the sum of even dice.

skulls.name: Shot Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if the middle die is different from all the other dice.

skulls.name: Spiked Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if the middle die is equal to the amount of odd dice.

skulls.name: Split Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if the sum of the two first dice is equal to the sum of the two last dice.

skulls.name: Swindler Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand that is the same rank as the previous played hand.
skulls.example: Play a Pair when the previous played hand is a Pair.

skulls.name: Tactical Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if the difference between the smallest and the largest die is larger than 3.

skulls.name: Trench Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if the largest die is smaller or equal to rerolls left.
skulls.example: Play 11122 when there are 3 rerolls left.

skulls.name: Trinity Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if the amount of rerolls is divisible by 3 and larger than 0.
skulls.example: Play a hand when the amount of rerolls is 3.

skulls.name: Vampire Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand that contains exactly a single die with the number 2.

skulls.name: Virtual Skull
skulls.condition: After a reroll if the sum of the rerolled dice is 8 or 10. Once per hand.
skulls.example: Reroll 11111 into 44111 by rerolling only the two first dice.

skulls.name: Weeping Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if every die was rerolled at least once.
skulls.example: Play a hand after rerolling all dice.

skulls.name: Welder Skull
skulls.condition: When playing a hand if there are at least four dice with the numbers 3 or 4.

skulls.name: Yule Skull
skulls.condition: When starting a new level if there were no hands left at the end of the previous level.
skulls.example: The previous level was finished with no hands left.

hands.name: Pair
hands.condition: Hand contains two of the same number.

hands.name: Three Of A Kind
hands.condition: Hand contains three of the same number.

hands.name: Flush
hands.condition: All dice in hand are of the same parity.

hands.name: Full House
hands.condition: Hand contains three of a kind and a pair.

hands.name: Flush House
hands.condition: Hand contains three of a kind and a pair of the same parity.

hands.name: Four Of A Kind
hands.condition: Hand contains four of the same number.

hands.name: Five Of A Kind
hands.condition: Hand contains five of the same number.

achievements.condition: Win and escape the Underworld five times.

achievements.condition: Win without using any skull rerolls.

achievements.condition: Complete a level with more rerolls than you started with.

achievements.condition: Score a TOTAL of 2500 or more with a single hand.

achievements.name: Compulsive Reroller
achievements.condition: Spend at least ten rerolls on a single hand.

achievements.name: Show-Off
achievements.condition: Upgrade and play every hand at least once during a run.

achievements.name: Skull Wave
achievements.condition: Activate at least 15 skulls at once when playing a hand.

achievements.name: High Roller
achievements.condition: Activate at least five skulls at once with a single reroll.

achievements.name: Calculated Risk
achievements.condition: Reduce a level to zero with no room to spare.

achievements.name: Praiseworthy
achievements.condition: Earn praise from Kalma five levels in a row.

achievements.name: Passive
achievements.condition: Activate at least three skulls at once due to a favourable initial roll.

achievements.name: Colorblind
achievements.condition: Win a run with only two colors of skulls in your deck.

achievements.name: Collector
achievements.condition: Collect all four different color variants of the same skull in a single run.

achievements.name: Hold My Dice
achievements.condition: Win a run without rerolling any dice.

achievements.name: Handholding
achievements.condition: Win a run having played 60 or fewer hands.

achievements.name: Three Of A Kind
achievements.condition: Play a Three of a Kind.

achievements.name: Four Of A Kind
achievements.condition: Play a Four of a Kind.

achievements.name: Five Of A Kind
achievements.condition: Play a Five of a Kind.

achievements.name: Blank Skull
achievements.condition: Win a run with a blank skull in your deck.

achievements.name: The Game Master
achievements.condition: Win a run with the total score of at least 250 000.

rerollAbilities.name: Classic Rerolls
rerollAbilities.availability: Classic is active; alternate selection not confirmed

rerollAbilities.name: Sticky Rerolls
rerollAbilities.description: - Rerolling rolls the selected dice. - Initial rolls do not roll the middle die. - Start every level with one less reroll.
rerollAbilities.availability: Classic is active; alternate selection not confirmed

rerollAbilities.name: Twin Rerolls
rerollAbilities.description: - Rerolling rolls the selected dice. - Exactly two dice can be rerolled at a time. - Start every level with one more reroll.
rerollAbilities.availability: Classic is active; alternate selection not confirmed

rerollAbilities.name: Chaotic Rerolls
rerollAbilities.description: - Rerolls roll all the dice. - Start every level with one more reroll.
rerollAbilities.availability: Classic is active; alternate selection not confirmed

rerollAbilities.name: Chained Rerolls
rerollAbilities.description: - Rerolling rolls the selected dice. - Every die can be rerolled only once per hand. - Start every level with two more rerolls.
rerollAbilities.availability: Classic is active; alternate selection not confirmed

rerollAbilities.name: Weighed Rerolls
rerollAbilities.description: - Rerolling rolls the selected dice. - Rerolling dice never increases their value. - Start every level with one less reroll.
rerollAbilities.availability: Classic is active; alternate selection not confirmed

rerollAbilities.name: Cogwheel Rerolls
rerollAbilities.description: - Rerolling increments the number of the selected die up by 1. - Rerolling a die with the number 6 turns it into 1. - Only one die can be rerolled at a time.
rerollAbilities.availability: Classic is active; alternate selection not confirmed

rerollAbilities.name: Reversing Rerolls
rerollAbilities.description: - Rerolling turns the selected die upside down. - Only one die can be rerolled at a time.
rerollAbilities.availability: Classic is active; alternate selection not confirmed

rerollAbilities.name: Sorting Rerolls
rerollAbilities.description: - Rerolling a die makes it swap its number with the number of the die to its right. - Rerolling the last die makes it swap its number with the first die. - Start the game with all hands upgraded once.
rerollAbilities.availability: Classic is active; alternate selection not confirmed

Build a deck of cursed skulls and try to survive as long as possible. Running out of hands is punished but does not end the game. Some statistics and records are not tracked.

- Rerolling rolls the selected dice. - Initial rolls do not roll the middle die. - Start every level with one less reroll.
- Rerolling rolls the selected dice. - Exactly two dice can be rerolled at a time. - Start every level with one more reroll.
- Rerolls roll all the dice. - Start every level with one more reroll.
- Rerolling rolls the selected dice. - Every die can be rerolled only once per hand. - Start every level with two more rerolls.
- Rerolling rolls the selected dice. - Rerolling dice never increases their value. - Start every level with one less reroll.
- Rerolling increments the number of the selected die up by 1. - Rerolling a die with the number 6 turns it into 1. - Only one die can be rerolled at a time.
- Rerolling turns the selected die upside down. - Only one die can be rerolled at a time.

- Rerolling a die makes it swap its number with the number of the die to its right. - Rerolling the last die makes it swap its number with the first die. - Start the game with all hands upgraded once.
